user.title: Connect to FiiO BTR5
user.description: Enter the Bluetooth MAC address of your BTR5. It will be sent one battery-level read as a one-time connectivity check before saving.

abort.already_configured: This BTR5 is already configured in Home Assistant.

error.invalid_mac: That doesn't look like a Bluetooth MAC address (expected format AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF).
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the BTR5 over Bluetooth. Make sure it is powered on, in range, and not already connected to another host.
